titles.zh-CN: GPU 执行与 CPU 对照

tutorial_instructions.en: Run a small GPU/CPU comparison; retain toolchain and numerical error.
tutorial_instructions.zh-CN: 运行小型 GPU/CPU 对照，保存工具链和数值误差。

fixed_conventions: SI; exp(+j omega t); RMS; sigma=58 MS/m; mu_r=1; 20 C

en: Execute the same small double-precision operations on CPU and GPU: matrix multiplication, a complex linear system with known solution and true residual, FFT and inverse roundtrip.

The comparison verifies arithmetic and runtime equivalence for the stated inputs. It does not establish a new physical solution, large-scale convergence or a performance advantage for a different workload.
zh-CN: 在 CPU 与 GPU 上执行相同的小型双精度运算：矩阵乘法、已知解复线性系统及真实残差、FFT 与逆变换回读。
对照验收当前输入的算术和运行时一致性；新物理场解、大规模收敛和其他负载性能须分别验证。
